coverage_note: Diarization very fragmented; many Medi fragments carry the ? label (e.g. 01:52 'أنا لقيت الطريق', 35:58-36:05 بسات/بَسْتَكْ, 58:11 betenbesti) - judged from content. 11:16-20:30 is English-only planning talk; 22:49-24:55 is a honey-seller interruption in English. 12:27-13:16, 20:31-30:25, 36:23-42:50 and 45:12-59:56 are Latin-transliterated by the engine, so ط/ت and vowel differences (basat/beset, F2/F3) are unreadable there; I skipped those as pronunciation. Root-letter slips (34:21 بنسبت, 56:04 ban sebet, 1:01:34 بيسبط) treated as S4 per brief, not rows. 13:16 'sehel ktir' -> her 'Ktir sehel?' left out (both orders acceptable). 44:44 ابستههم -> her أبستيهم 'Good' left out (unclear whether a fix or a feminine variant). 00:39 'software لقة' too garbled to file beyond the لغة didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: Nerd بعرف، انتَ بتعرف-
rows.why: He addresses Amal (female) with the masculine you-form; she answered without fixing it; label/transcript may be off.

rows.medi_said: How do you say languages in it? Loka, lokat?
rows.why: He asked how to say 'language(s)' after trying 'لقة/loka'; she supplied لغة - a didn't-know, not on her sheet.

rows.medi_said: What language?
rows.amal_said: No بلاقي، إنتا بتلاقي، شو لقيت؟
rows.right: لقيت = you found (شو لقيت؟ = what did you find?)
rows.why: He heard her شو لقيت as 'what language'; she explained the verb بلاقي/بتلاقي; sheet has 'you (m) found | inta la2ait | إنت لقيت'.

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير
rows.why: He said طريق (road) for 'way/method'; she prompted 'طريق أو طريقة؟' and he fixed to طريقة; sheet: 'road / way / route | 6ariq | طريق' vs 'way / method | Tariqa | طريقة'. Line is labelled ? but is his.
rows.english: I found a very good way

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير
rows.why: طريقة is feminine so the adjective should be منيحة; she only fixed the noun and let the adjective pass.

rows.medi_said: الأحسن
rows.why: He put el- on the comparative (الأحسن); she recast 'شو أحسن طريقة' - comparatives never take el-.

rows.medi_said: To learn would be أتأل-- or يتعلّم
rows.why: For 'best way to learn' he offered the he-form يتعلّم; she said لا, it is أتعلم (I-form, no b-) and later 'Both' when he asked if it also means plain 'to learn'.

rows.medi_said: Okay. أتعلم لغة جديد
rows.why: لغة is feminine; the adjective needs -a (جديدة); she moved on without fixing.

rows.medi_said: مع عربي فلسطيني
rows.why: Definite 'the Palestinian Arabic' should carry el- on noun and adjective; let pass.

rows.medi_said: بس إذا إذا بقدر آم أصلح
rows.right: إذا أقدر (per bucket B3; my reading)
rows.why: Bucket B3 says no b- after iza; he kept the b- on بقدر and she let it pass (very common in speech, so low).

rows.medi_said: بقدر آم أصلح، أصلحه آم…
rows.amal_said: أصلّحها بي لأنه مشكلة is a feminine
rows.why: The object ending must be feminine because مشكلة is feminine; she recast أصلحها and named the reason.

rows.medi_said: I excited؟ أنا بهمس.
rows.why: He used the make-form بحمّس (I excite) for 'I get excited'; she recast the get-form بتحمس (sheet: 'i get excited | Ana bat7ammas | أنا بتحمس').

rows.medi_said: shit! أنا بتحمس. amm أنا بتحمس شو بنقدر
rows.amal_said: So neither not تحمس not بهمِس. What is it? ... ✓ صح.
rows.why: He meant 'I am excited' (state), so neither verb fits; she prompted until he produced the participle متحمس (sheet: 'excited | mit7ammes | متحمس لَ').

rows.medi_said: متحمس من possibility.
rows.why: Her sheet gives 'متحمس لَ'; he used من; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: If, أي كلمات، مشكلة، مشكل-- yeah. عندي
rows.why: After أي (any/which) the noun stays singular; she recast أي كلمة; could also be read as her asking 'which word?'.

rows.medi_said: أي كلمة مشكلة اللي-
rows.why: 'Any word I have a problem with' needs the preposition + pronoun فيها pointing back; she finished his sentence and he repeated it.
rows.english: any word that I have a problem with

rows.medi_said: il grammar. Do I know grammar?
rows.why: He asked for 'grammar'; she supplied قواعد; not on her sheet - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: Do I know the word for repeat? Is it تكرار？ ... What is to repeat?
rows.amal_said: Repeat يعني أنا بعيد is I repeat.
rows.why: He asked for the verb 'to repeat'; she explained تكرار is the noun and gave بعيد; not on her sheet.

rows.medi_said: ana بعيد الـ، الـ نفس مش الـ-
rows.why: Idafa: the first word (نفس) never takes el-, the owner does; she said No and recast نفس المشكلة; he then repeated 'أنا بعيد الـ نفس مشكلة' at 08:44.

rows.medi_said: ل-لما الـ سؤال ما عند-- ما عنده، جواب
rows.amal_said: صحيح. لما ما يكون عنده جواب للـ السؤال
rows.wrong: لما الـ سؤال ما عنده جواب
rows.right: لما ما يكون عنده جواب للسؤال
rows.why: After لما the 'to be' verb ykoon is needed; she recast with ما يكون عنده.
rows.english: when it doesn't have an answer to the question

rows.medi_said: an easy answer, I should say.
rows.why: He had just said جواب in Arabic then clarified in English; she supplied جواب سهل; sheet: 'easy | Sahel | سهل'. Low because it reads as a meta aside.

rows.medi_said: al-, el ghayr tariqa-
rows.amal_said: Not el, just ghayr ghayr tariqa
rows.why: ghayr (another/other) + noun takes no el-; she said 'Not el, just ghayr'.

rows.medi_said: Shuyani. Muhadath-... Hold on. This is present. No, muhadath... Muhadatha. I don't remember.
rows.why: She asked shu ya3ni muhadatha; he could not recall; sheet: 'conversation practice | Mu7aadase | محادثة'.

rows.medi_said: muhadatha ma qalil kalima.
rows.why: Adjective before the noun and singular for 'few words'; adjective goes after and noun plural; 'ma' for مع is pronunciation; let pass.

rows.medi_said: that was zaj. What shuu, shu yanni banzaj?
rows.why: He asked the meaning; sheet: 'i get annoyed | Ana banze3ej | أنا بنزعج'.

rows.medi_said: Bahrej. Bahrej. Shu yanni?
rows.right: ba7rej = I embarrass; ban7erej = I get embarrassed
rows.why: He asked the meaning; sheet: 'i embarrass | Ana ba7rej | أنا بحرج', 'i get embarrassed | Ana ban7erej | أنا بنحرج'.

rows.medi_said: maruj baru... Is it m-maruj? M-mitruj?
rows.why: He tried the participle 'embarrassed' with a mit- pattern; she gave ma7ruj (ma- pattern).

rows.medi_said: Oh my God, bees. What was bees? Bee.
rows.why: He asked for 'bees'; sheet: 'bees (general) | Na7el | نحل'.

rows.medi_said: ahana shay na'na' ma asal mufrad. Al-muftadi wa mufrad-
rows.why: He seems to mean 'tea with honey only / instead of sugar' and used mufrad (singular); she guessed 'mesh sukkar?' and moved on; also no verb 'I drink'.
rows.english: I take mint tea with honey only, not sugar

rows.medi_said: oo khatibti bih teb al-- bih teb al-asal ma labneh kateer.
rows.why: Subject is my fiancée (f) so the verb should be بتحب, not بيحب; Latin transcript is ambiguous; she only asked about the labneh.
rows.english: my fiancée likes honey with labneh a lot

rows.medi_said: Ana hakeet ma khatibti ashan Arabiyi. Arabiyi, aswad or-
rows.why: He used aswad (black) for 'bad'; she supplied sayyi2; sheet: 'bad | Sayyi2 | سيء' vs 'black (m/f) | Aswad | أسود'.

rows.medi_said: Ana hakeet ma khatibti ashan Arabiyi.
rows.why: 'I talked with my fiancée about my Arabic' - 3ashaan means because/for the sake of, not 'about'; she let it pass.
rows.english: I talked with my fiancée about my Arabic

rows.medi_said: getting worse so she would it be akun, akunsayye'?
rows.why: 'Is getting worse' needs 3am + بصير (becoming), not أكون (be); she recast 3am baseer sayyi2 and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: Bansabit? But-
rows.amal_said: No, forget everything. Bas ihkili shi ya'ani happy as a siffa.
rows.why: Asked for 'happy' as an adjective he gave the verb banbeset (I get happy); she said No, wants the sifa; he reached mabsut (sheet: 'happy | Mabsoo6 | مبسوط').

rows.medi_said: Qeem kamar marra?
rows.why: She said n2eemha (remove the N); he could not place the verb and asked; sheet: 'i remove / take away | Ba2eem | بقيم'.

rows.medi_said: Does go back to the أو
rows.why: For the present of بسّط he proposed the u-vowel of مبسوط (ببسوط); she said لا, nothing is added, it is babset.

rows.medi_said: It makes me happy مضارع present tense امmm so this is with an right؟
rows.amal_said: Which n لا ليش؟ We're still in this verb
rows.why: 'It makes me happy' is the make-form (بسّط); he reached for the get-form with N; she said لا.

rows.medi_said: so بيسبوت بيسبيت sorry بيسبت.
rows.amal_said: هلأ ليش هلأ الباء أول واحدة ... the present بس بضل be here and verb is BC6 or T. So bib set two Bs
rows.why: He-present needs the b- prefix kept before y + the root b: بيبسط; he collapsed to one ب; she explained the two Bs and he produced بييبستني.

rows.medi_said: sorry هية بتيبست- يبستوا and احنا بين- بينبست.
rows.why: We-form takes bn- (بنبسّط), not by-n; she prompted 'احنا' and then recast بنبسط; his second try بنسبت is a root-letter slip (S4).

rows.medi_said: هية بتيبست- يبستوا
rows.why: They-form present dropped the b- prefix; she let it pass while moving to احنا.

rows.medi_said: اه بسات- بساتِ- بساتِتني أسف بساتِتك.
rows.why: 'I made you happy' is basatt-ak; he inserted an extra syllable (basatit-ak); the ? line بَسْتَكْ reads as her recast and he then said 'Ok بسَتَّكْ'.

rows.medi_said: basati is she, she makes happy right?
rows.amal_said: No,- Or you make happy female ...that's you. You make happy.
rows.why: He read the -i ending as 'she'; she said No, it is you (f).

rows.medi_said: hold on. These words are jumbling together now this is problem. Laeit, laeit mal
rows.why: In her sentence 'basatini lama haketili innek laiti shughal' he could not place laiti; she explained balaa2i; sheet: 'you (f) found | inti la2aiti | إنتي لقيتي'.

rows.medi_said: when I tell you about what I found.
rows.right: lama haketili = when you told me
rows.why: He flipped the past you-form + -li (to me) into 'I tell you'; she repeated it until he got 'when you told me' at 42:15.

rows.medi_said: And about you.
rows.why: He read innek (inno + you) as 'about you'; she glossed 'that you'.

rows.medi_said: I'm happy that you, that you told me you found work.
rows.amal_said: You made me happy when you- Yeah ... told me you found work.
rows.why: Whole-sentence read-back turned basatini (you made me happy) into 'I'm happy'; she restated it.
rows.english: you made me happy when you told me you found work

rows.medi_said: Y- you don't put a E, right? It's just بسّت؟ بستي؟ بستي، بستو.
rows.amal_said: No. ليش ما منحط إي بدنا إي ... بست. إبست We do need an E. ... No, because it's three consonants or more.
rows.why: Command of بسّط needs the initial i- (إبسّط) because the stem has three consonants; she said No and named the rule; he then gave ابست، ابستي، ابسطو.

rows.medi_said: is it nabasit or is it, nabasat? Or nabast?
rows.amal_said: So now we do need to add something to make it easier to say. ... So inbasat.
rows.why: Past of the get-happy verb (انبسط) needs the helping i- before n; he guessed nabasat; she explained and gave inbasat.

rows.medi_said: Huwa. hiya inbas- inbashatat.
rows.why: She-form past انبسطت; he added an extra vowel/syllable; she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: embasana.
rows.why: We-form past needs the -t- before -na (انبسطنا); he dropped it; she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: this would be embasattet, right? Embassatet il hafla.
rows.amal_said: EMBASATI. I need a preposition. What was it? Do you remember? ... Bi or
rows.why: انبسط takes bi/fi before its object ('did you enjoy the party' = enjoy IN the party); he dropped the preposition; she prompted and gave bi/fi (sheet: 'enjoy (plural) your trip! | Enbes6u bi-re7letkom').

rows.medi_said: In basatu Their trip. Safarhom. Safarhom.
rows.why: Same verb, same missing preposition; she prompted 'fee preposition' and he added bi.

rows.medi_said: Safarhom. Safarhom.
rows.why: سفرة (trip, f) grows -t before the possessive ending: safret-hom; he said safarhom; she recast and he repeated safarthom (sheet: '(travel) trip | Safra | سفرة').

rows.medi_said: Inti beten bestiti
rows.why: You-f present of انبسط is btenbesti; he doubled the ending; she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: Ana, ana ban biscuit. ashann ihna aa taalam natal ana naataallam
rows.why: 'because we learn' - he dropped the b- and mixed ana with the we-form; she recast ihna bnet3allam (b- kept because 3ashaan here means because; sheet 'i learn | Ana bat3allam').
rows.english: I get happy because we learn

rows.medi_said: ihna bantalaam bass Hadi al filll
rows.why: فعل (verb) is masculine so the demonstrative is hada, not hadi; she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: Enjoy your day So command tensing Investii yomek
rows.why: انبسط needs bi before its object even in the command; he dropped it again; she recast 'bi yomek'.

rows.medi_said: Oh, the most happy. Did you say أحسن or أكثر؟ أحسن right?
rows.amal_said: شو أكتر إشي. ... No. The best thing is أحسن إشي.
rows.why: He heard/assumed أحسن (best) in her question; she said no, it is أكتر إشي (the most); sheet: 'the most | Aktar shee | أكتر شيء'.
rows.english: the thing that makes you happiest

rows.medi_said: So الأكتر إشي-
rows.why: Comparative/superlative takes no el-; she said No, just أكتر إشي.

rows.medi_said: إشي and then I have to say إلي right؟
rows.why: He wanted to insert illi after أكتر إشي; she said no illi here; asked before producing, so low.
rows.english: the thing that makes me happiest

rows.medi_said: بيبسطني لماaa would this be conditional؟ لما بكون في الطبيعة؟
rows.why: After لما the b- drops on بكون → أكون; she recast and he repeated 'لما اكون'.

rows.medi_said: to make someone happy is آآá بيسبط.
rows.amal_said: ببسّط. ... No و and الب goes-- I should make you record just ببسط
rows.why: For 'to make someone happy' he gave a he-prefixed, letter-swapped form; she recast ببسّط (the I-form she uses as the citation form; sheet 'it causes happiness | Byebse6 | بيبسط'); the letter order part is S4.

rows.medi_said: عافيا فيكي. شكرًا.
rows.why: The reply to يعطيك العافية is الله يعافيكي; his 'عافيا فيكي' is not a set phrase; she let it pass; not on her sheet.
